title: Lusin's theorem on ℝⁿ with closed sets for (ℝⁿ)*-valued Borel maps (infinite-measure form of Simon Ch. 1, Thm 1.17)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let S ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be a Borel set, let f : ℝⁿ → (ℝⁿ)* = L(ℝⁿ, ℝ) (operator-norm topology, Borel σ-algebra) be Borel measurable, and let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a closed set C ⊆ ℝⁿ with C ⊆ S, Lⁿ(S ∖ C) < ε (Lⁿ = volume) and f|C continuous.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl n → (Eucl n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), MeasurableSet S → Measurable f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed C ∧ C ⊆ S ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (S \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn f C
